content.title: Pershing Square Backs Howard Hughes $2.1 Billion Vantage Bid
content.summary: Bill Ackman’s hedge fund agreed to buy non-voting preferred shares issued by Howard Hughes, according to a statement Thursday.  Howard Hughes said in a separate statement that it was buying Vantage for about $2.1 billion.  Pershing Square is Howard Hughes’ largest shareholder, with Ackman seeking to turn it from a real estate company with master-planned communities and other properties into a company with controlling stakes in other public and private businesses.
